## 0.4.8

- Themes. Pick a look in Settings > Appearance: Rail (the new default), Paper, Classic, Contrast, Focus, Glass, Ledger, Mono, Nord, Soft and Terminal. Settings, the Listening pill, the setup guide, Report a problem and the tray menu all follow it.
- A new Settings home with your push-to-talk key, a live microphone level and a cleanup preview, plus More settings for everything else.
- History shows which app each new dictation went into, and you can play back, copy or delete it.
- Snippets and word rules have new editors.
